title: Participative Research for Individualized Care in Cardiovascular Diseases
summary:
Cardiovascular diseases are varied and are mostly chronic diseases that affect the heart and blood vessels. They can cause serious health problems and require ongoing medical attention. 
The aim of the study is to set up four country-specific discussion groups with patients, so-called Patient Panels, in Belgium, Germany, Ireland, and the United Kingdom. A Patient Panel is a group of people with a specific disease who are actively involved in medical research or a specific project. In the case of this study, these are patients with a cardiovascular disease. With the help of the Panel, the ideas, experiences, wishes and needs of various patients will be identified, for better diagnostics, treatment and self-care in cardiovascular diseases. 
As a Patient Panel Member, patients will need to complete four overarching tasks over 3.5 years: (1) identification of measurement tools relevant to patients, e.g., questionnaires that reflect patients perceived state of health and experiences with medical care, so-called Patient Reported Outcome and Patient Reported Experience Measures (PROMs and PREMs); (2) development of a concept to support and motivate patients to adhere to treatment and the associated behaviors; (3) feedback on the patient journey of individual patients; (4) usability test of a digital tool. These tasks each consist of several activities.
conditions: CVD at different stages: (1) (early) risk to develop CVD, irrespectively if treated or not; (2) established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) with normal cardiac function defined as the absence of structural of functional cardiac abnormalities; (3) presence of structural and/or functional cardiac abnormality without the diagnosis of HF; (4) chronic HF (independently of left ventricular ejection fraction)

interventions.name: Four country-specific Patient Panels from different European countries (Belgium, Germany, Ireland, United Kingdom), each consisting of 10-12 patients. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients
- Be at risk to develop a CVD or diagnosis of a CVD
- Ability to participate in in-person meetings
- Willingness to participate in a Patient Panel
- Ability to give informed consent

Relatives participating in a Patient Panel as a representative of a patient with CVD, must be actively involved in their care and fulfil the same inclusion criteria as patients (except “be at risk to develop a CVD or diagnosis of a CVD”). 

Healthcare professionals
- Profession in the CVD sector
- Ability and willingness to participate
Exclusion criteria:
Patients and relatives
- Serious cognitive impairment
- Insufficient language skills

Healthcare professionals
- Insufficient language skills
- Insufficient technological skills
- No access to a device with internet connection
